PresenceClientKind.description: Which kind of client is reporting. It sets the default for `canPostBanners`: a desktop client posts banners, a web client says so.

description: A client's presence lease, renewed while it runs. A lease expires 30 s after its last report; `gone` ends it at once, as a closing window does.

canPostBanners.description: Whether this client can post OS banners now. Absent: a desktop client can and a web client cannot. A browser tab whose person denied notifications says `false`.
